title: Recency-weighted petition count
hypothesis: Users who signed more petitions recently are more likely to take follow-up actions.
tier_rationale: Strong prior signal from similar projects.

title: Email open-rate in prior 30 days
hypothesis: Higher email engagement predicts willingness to act on petition follow-ups.
tier_rationale: Email engagement is a strong proxy for platform engagement.

title: Geographic political alignment
hypothesis: Users in politically active regions may have higher action rates.
